title: categoryComparison request
description: Categories as bars: without order they lie down, sorted by value; with an order they stand upright in that order. One row per category, computed in the warehouse (REQ-058): sum (a bar from zero), mean with sd (a diamond over a thin bar) or median with p25 and p75 (a dot in a wide bar). Give the time the values cover: window, period or day.

metric.description: Identifier of the metric, e.g. creditLeads. Used as title when no title is given.

title.description: Title above the chart. States what is shown, not a conclusion.

measureType.description: Kind of number: additive or unique for a count, perUnit for a mean or median per unit such as an amount per lead (REQ-070). ratio, a share with a numerator and a denominator, is not available yet. Required until Domain Hub or the dbt YAML supplies it.

uniqueAggregation.description: Required for unique counts: daily (the uniques per day; never summed) or overPeriod (the uniques over the whole block, counted in the warehouse; only as a total).

statistic.description: The value per category: sum (an amount, a bar from zero), mean (a diamond with ±1 sd) or median (a dot with P25–P75). A row carries only the fields of this statistic.

ordered.description: true for categories with an order, such as price ranges: upright bars in the order given. false (the default) for categories without order, such as provinces: lying bars, sorted by value. Never dates: a date axis is a line (REQ-001, REQ-002).

window.description: The values cover the window of this many days that ends on the last complete day.

period.description: The values cover this ISO calendar period: 2026-W40, 2026-09, 2026-Q3 or 2026. It must be over.

day.description: The values are a snapshot on this day, such as the listings online.

asOf.description: The last complete day of the data. Yesterday in Brussels when absent.

unit.description: The unit around every number of the metric, e.g. { "prefix": "€ " } or { "suffix": " d" }.

format.description: Output format. Only svg is available in v0.

locale.description: Language of titles, labels and messages, e.g. en or nl-BE. Unknown locales fall back to English.

context.description: Provenance and status for the footer. Missing values are shown as unknown.

meta.description: Metadata of the chart (REQ-010): the question that started it, references, the query, who asked and who built it, and the day it was compiled. Only what is given is shown (REQ-020).

question.description: The question that started the chart.

references.description: Links to Jira, Slack or anything else.

query.description: The query behind the data, shown as written.

compiledOn.description: The day the chart was compiled. When absent, the day it is drawn, in Brussels.

points.description: One row per category, computed in the warehouse (REQ-058). A category without data has null: it is drawn as empty, never as zero.

category.description: The name of the category, as the reader should see it.

sum.description: The total of the block; null when the block has no data.

mean.description: The mean of the block; null when the block has no data.

sd.description: Sample standard deviation (n − 1, like STDDEV in BigQuery).

n.description: Number of observations behind the value, as counted where the value is computed (REQ-043).

median.description: The median of the block; null when the block has no data.
